Corollary
[Comparison principle]1. Corollary 2.9\group ch02-maximum-principles Source: han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0032 Suppose $u\in C^2(\Omega )\cap C(\overline\Omega )$, $Lu\ge 0$, $c\le 0$ in $\Omega $, and $u\le 0$ on $\partial \Omega $. Then $u\le 0$ in $\Omega $; moreover, either $u<0$ there or $u\equiv 0$.
